title: vouacapoua vermifuga
intro: Vouacapoua vermifuga, commonly known as the "vermifuge tree," is a plant species native to the tropical forests of West Africa. The health benefits of Vouacapoua vermifuga include its use in traditional medicine to treat parasitic infections, particularly those caused by worms, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be attributed to its ability to stimulate digestive enzymes and enhance immune function. The bioactive constituents of Vouacapoua vermifuga include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
